title: 特斯拉與電動汽車工程
summary: 以電池、驅動、熱管理、車身與軟體的整體整合為主線，建立安全的虛擬製造學習流程。
summaryEn: Study battery, drive, thermal, body and software integration in a safe virtual manufacturing workflow.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創汽車與交通工具教學。所有數值均為明示假設，不是同名車輛的實測規格、認證或維修設定。使用試算表、紙面圖、合成資料及自行準備的離線模型；不提供真實高壓、道路、壓力設備或控制器操作授權。
scopeEn: Original automotive teaching based on public principles. All numerical inputs are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vehicle specifications, certification criteria or maintenance settings. Use worksheets, paper diagrams, synthetic data and offline models you prepare; no authorization for real high-voltage, road, pressure-equipment or controller operations.

knowledge.text: 比較平路恆速與上坡情境。
knowledge.textEn: Compare steady level travel and climbing.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「特斯拉與電動汽車工程」的「建立行駛能耗模型」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出儲能、驅動、熱路徑、感測與停止的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「車輛台架：續航與停止」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與隔離低壓車模的負載、能源、時間與停止位置紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Build a driving-energy model” in “Tesla and Electric Vehicle Engineering”. Draw the storage, drive, thermal path, sensing and stopping boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Vehicle Bench: Endurance and Stopping” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for load, energy, timing and stopping-position records from an isolated low-voltage model, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.checkEn: Compare steady level travel and climbing.
